question: Do maintainers accept the schema-10 migration and durable observation-ordering contract for existing v0.7.1 and intermediate archives at this exact head?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this PR changes persisted schema and state-replacement semantics; only maintainers can accept that compatibility boundary for release.

options.title: Accept after changelog removal
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry, retain the tested schema-10 migration and ordering design, and merge after final checks remain green.

options.title: Request narrower migration scope
options.body: Keep the draft open and reduce or split the schema-convergence work if maintainers do not accept the current upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept after changelog removal
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog entry, retain the tested schema-10 migration and ordering design, and merge after final checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: The original store, SQLC, atomic hydration, and release baseline history makes @steipete the strongest available owner for accepting the upgrade contract.
